title: Buffs on the field skip a paid Tribute
notes: R2261000: on the field a Nerf or a Buff never draws a card's Tribute from the X row, paid as it was played; in a hand or a deck it still does, and the play now asks for the Tribute it left (play_choices::tribute_cost_of read the printed one). R2261001: Param.cry names a face ("base" or "radiant") for a number only that face's Cry reads while the other face's lasting text reads it too, out of reach on the field while the card shows that face; Gachaholic's lucky is cry: "base".

player.title: Buffs on the field skip a paid Tribute
changes: A Buff or a Nerf on a card on the field no longer changes its Tribute, which was paid when it was played.
A Buff or a Nerf on Gachaholic on the field no longer changes its Lucky while it is not Radiant, its Cry having run.
fixes: A Buff or a Nerf that changed a card's Tribute in your hand or deck now changes the Tribute its play asks for.
